## Valero Energy Corporation (VLO) `[Energy]`
- Valero shares closed down 4.10% on Thursday, October 15, 2026; an October 15 report cited profit-taking after a recent rally, technical overbought conditions, and short-term volatility in refining crack spreads, while describing the stock as trading near multi-year highs ahead of its October 22 earnings release (TradingKey, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated).
- Valero’s shares traded as low as $437.02 and were last quoted at $444.445 during Thursday’s session; 2,512,636 shares had traded, 24% below the reported average volume of 3,322,583 shares (The Stock Observer, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated).
- Citigroup analyst Vikram Bagri reportedly maintained a Hold rating while raising Valero’s price target to $485 from $302; the report cited long-term refinery capture trends and wider heavy-crude discounts, while flagging refining-cycle and renewable-diesel risks [report] (Business Insider, Oct 14, 2026, updated Oct 15; publish time not stated).
- Jefferies lowered its Valero price target to $394 from $401 and kept a Hold rating on October 8, 2026 (The Stock Observer, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated).
- Wells Fargo analyst Sam Margolin maintained a Buy rating and set a $485 price target; Wells Fargo had raised its target from $389 to $485 on October 14, 2026 (Business Insider, Oct 14, 2026, updated Oct 15; publish time not stated).
- A sector note cited temporary easing in gasoline and diesel crack spreads, commodity-price adjustments, and systematic fund reductions across refining equities; no specific peer moves were reported (TradingKey, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated).
- No after-hours or pre-market catalyst or price move before 02:03 ET on Friday, October 16, 2026 was identified in the available results.
